question:
$2.$ 已知函数 $f(x)=\begin{cases}2(x-1),&x<1,\\ \ln x,&x\ge1\end{cases}$，则 $f(x)$ 的一个原函数是( )

$(A)$ $F(x) = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll} (x - 1)^2, & x < 1 \\ x(\ln x - 1), & x \ge 1 \end{array} \right.$ \quad

$(B)$ $F(x) = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll} (x - 1)^2, & x < 1 \\ x(\ln x + 1) - 1, & x \ge 1 \end{array} \right.$ \quad

$(C)$ $F(x) = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll} (x - 1)^2, & x < 1 \\ x(\ln x + 1) + 1, & x \ge 1 \end{array} \right.$ \quad

$(D)$ $F(x) = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll} (x - 1)^2, & x < 1 \\ x(\ln x - 1) + 1, & x \ge 1 \end{array} \right.$
